approvers: Owner decides; site manager and coating-maker compatibility letter
reason: I pay about 12 euro per m2 today with film and my own labour, and this is 19, or 14 for a pilot with no Maltese reference. Spend is only about 5,000 a year, so the saving from fewer damaged frames has to be big to justify paying more.
objection: Anything wet on coated glass or finished frames that leaves a mark or residue is my problem, not yours. A 2,500 euro cap does not cover a block of coated units, and nobody here has used it yet.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and board with tape, applied and removed by our own crew.
would_change_my_mind: A test panel on our own glass and frames with the coating maker's written sign-off, and a local reference job showing it costs no more than about 12 to 14 per m2 all-in or clearly cuts my damage claims.
